first_tools.name: Your link page
first_tools.text: Every link you've got on one page, in your own style — your colors, your fonts, your logo. Set it up once and drop it in every bio. Now with plug-in money channels and QR codes — tips, $cashtags, and wallet addresses, each with its own scannable code.

first_tools.name: Scene kits
first_tools.text: Starting-soon, BRB, and ending screens that match your look, plus a webcam frame and a schedule card. Static and simple — drop them straight into OBS.

first_tools.name: Panels generator
first_tools.text: Channel panels that match your theme — About, Rules, Schedule, Socials, Support, Specs — exported ready to upload at exactly 320 wide.

first_tools.name: Overlays + alerts
first_tools.text: Browser-source overlays and an alerts box that pops loud — follows, subs, and tips in your theme, right in OBS, Streamlabs, Meld, or TikTok LIVE Studio. No installs, no downloads.

note: Priced like a friend on purpose: a generous free tier, and Crew at $3.69 a month — the tools are how streamers find us; the merch is the business. Built by one human and his AI superpower — the ideas are human, the execution is amplified.
